perks.title: 10% off at McCafferty's
perks.detail: Show your Lane Card at the bar on any matchday and get 10% off food & drink.

perks.title: 6th home game free
perks.detail: Check in at five home games and your sixth is on the club. Shown automatically on your card.

news.title: Members get first dibs on 2026-27 season tickets
news.body: Lane family members will get an early window to grab season tickets before they go on general sale. Keep an eye on your inbox.
